hook_text: R127,51 or R127,52 per learner? 22 cents decides who pays the bus driver.
clip_script: Context decides rounding: when collecting money to cover a cost, round UP, otherwise the total is short. Thirty-eight times R127,51 is R4 845,38, which is twenty-two cents short. So the school charges R127,52, or rounds up to R128 so the full cost is covered.
visual_style: A school bus with a R4 845,60 ticket; 38 learner icons each drop coins; a counter falls 22 cents short in red, then rounds up and turns green.
pacing: Quick setup, tension on the shortfall, resolve with rounding up.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to plan a whole school trip with decimals.
